entries.speaker: adam
entries.text: [warmly] Hey there, Cyber Hero! I've got a secret... just for you. [whispers] Come a little closer. Your password is like a magic key — and it's all yours. It's how the computer knows it's really YOU. [nervous] A weak little key? Uh-oh... that lets the sneaky Raccoon slip right in. [excited] But a big, strong one? [laughs] He doesn't stand a chance!
